icons.openingTag:
<button
              type="button"
              aria-label="Clear style search"
              onClick={() => {
                setQuery("");
                searchInput.current?.focus();
              }}
            >

<DialogClose
                className="ex-close"
                aria-label="Close style details"
              >

<button
                          className="cx-link"
                          aria-label={`Move ${section} section earlier`}
                          disabled={!sectionIndex}
                          onClick={() => moveSection(section, -1)}
                        >

<button
                          className="cx-link"
                          aria-label={`Move ${section} section later`}
                          disabled={sectionIndex === sections.length - 1}
                          onClick={() => moveSection(section, 1)}
                        >

<button
                        className="cx-link"
                        aria-label="Move dish up"
                        disabled={
                          !rows
                            .slice(0, selectedIndex)
                            .some((r) => r.category === row.category)
                        }
                        onClick={() => move(selectedIndex, -1)}
                      >

<button
                        className="cx-link"
                        aria-label="Move dish down"
                        disabled={
                          !rows
                            .slice(selectedIndex + 1)
                            .some((r) => r.category === row.category)
                        }
                        onClick={() => move(selectedIndex, 1)}
                      >

<button
            aria-label="Previous page"
            disabled={page <= 1}
            onClick={() => setPage((p) => p - 1)}
          >

<button
            aria-label="Next page"
            disabled={!result || page >= result.pages}
            onClick={() => setPage((p) => p + 1)}
          >

<button
            aria-label="Zoom out"
            disabled={effectiveZoom <= 25}
            onClick={() => changeZoom(-20)}
          >

<button
            aria-label="Zoom in"
            disabled={effectiveZoom >= 200}
            onClick={() => changeZoom(20)}
          >
<button className="md-icon" aria-label="Close dialog" onClick={close}>

<button
            className="md-icon"
            aria-label={`Remove ${kind === "variants" ? "option" : "add-on"} ${index + 1}${v.label ? `: ${v.label}` : ""}`}
            onClick={() => change(values.filter((o) => o.id !== v.id))}
          >

<button
            className="md-icon"
            aria-label={`Move ${item.name || "untitled dish"} earlier`}
            disabled={index === 0}
            onClick={() => reorder(-1)}
          >

<button
            className="md-icon"
            aria-label={`Move ${item.name || "untitled dish"} later`}
            disabled={index === section.items.length - 1}
            onClick={() => reorder(1)}
          >

<button
            className="md-icon"
            aria-label={`Move ${section.name || "untitled section"} earlier`}
            disabled={!index}
            onClick={() => reorder(-1)}
          >

<button
            className="md-icon"
            aria-label={`Move ${section.name || "untitled section"} later`}
            disabled={index === count - 1}
            onClick={() => reorder(1)}
          >

<button
                  className="md-icon md-more-actions"
                  aria-label="More menu actions"
                >

<button
                className="md-icon"
                aria-label="Undo menu change"
                title="Undo"
                disabled={!store.canUndo || !!busy}
                onClick={store.undo}
              >

<button
                className="md-icon"
                aria-label="Redo menu change"
                title="Redo"
                disabled={!store.canRedo || !!busy}
                onClick={store.redo}
              >

<button
                className="md-icon"
                aria-label="Dismiss error"
                onClick={() => setError("")}
              >

<button
            className="ps2-icon-button"
            aria-label="Cancel adjustments"
            disabled={busy}
            onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)}
          >

<button
            className="ps2-icon-button"
            aria-label="Close photo set"
            disabled={busy}
            onClick={onClose}
          >

<button
            className="ps2-icon-button"
            aria-label="Close food correction"
            disabled={busy}
            onClick={onClose}
          >

<button
            className="ps2-icon-button"
            disabled={busy}
            aria-label="Close download"
            onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)}
          >

<button
            className="ps2-icon-button"
            aria-label="Cancel inspiration"
            disabled={locked.current}
            onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)}
          >

<button
                className="pw-mobile-menu-trigger"
                aria-label="Open navigation"
              >

<button
                                className="cx-link cx-icon"
                                aria-label={`Move ${i.name} earlier`}
                                disabled={!index}
                                onClick={() => {
                                  const next = [...items];
                                  [next[index - 1], next[index]] = [
                                    next[index],
                                    next[index - 1],
                                  ];
                                  update({ items: next });
                                }}
                              >

<button
                                className="cx-link cx-icon"
                                aria-label={`Move ${i.name} later`}
                                disabled={index === items.length - 1}
                                onClick={() => {
                                  const next = [...items];
                                  [next[index + 1], next[index]] = [
                                    next[index],
                                    next[index + 1],
                                  ];
                                  update({ items: next });
                                }}
                              >

<button
                                className="cx-link cx-icon cx-danger"
                                aria-label={`Remove ${i.name}`}
                                onClick={() =>
                                  update({
                                    items: items.filter((_, n) => n !== index),
                                  })
                                }
                              >

<button
              className="cx-icon"
              aria-label="Close restaurant settings"
              disabled={working}
              onClick={requestClose}
            >

<button
            className="ps2-icon-button"
            disabled={store.busy}
            aria-label="Close saved look"
            onClick={onClose}
          >

<button
              className="ps2-icon-button"
              aria-label={`${library.favorites.includes(look.id) ? "Remove" : "Add"} ${look.name} ${library.favorites.includes(look.id) ? "from" : "to"} favorites`}
              aria-pressed={library.favorites.includes(look.id)}
              disabled={busy}
              onClick={() => void store.favorite(look.id)}
            >

<button
                      className="ps2-icon-button"
                      aria-label={`Use saved look ${look.name}`}
                      disabled={unavailable(look)}
                      onClick={() => apply(look)}
                    >

<button
              className="ps2-icon-button"
              aria-label="Close style browser"
              onClick={() => setBrowserOpen(false)}
            >

<button
                            aria-label="Clear search"
                            onClick={() => {
                              changeQuery("");
                              searchInput.current?.focus();
                            }}
                          >

<button
                                className="ps2-favorite"
                                aria-label={`${saved.library.favorites.includes(style.id) ? "Remove" : "Add"} ${style.name} ${saved.library.favorites.includes(style.id) ? "from" : "to"} favorites`}
                                aria-pressed={saved.library.favorites.includes(
                                  style.id,
                                )}
                                disabled={saved.busy || !saved.ready}
                                onClick={() => void saved.favorite(style.id)}
                              >

<button
              className="ps2-icon-button"
              aria-label="Cancel customization"
              onClick={() => setCustomOpen(false)}
            >

<button
              className="ps2-icon-button"
              aria-label="Cancel saving look"
              onClick={() => setSaveOpen(false)}
            >

<button
              className="ps2-icon-button"
              aria-label="Close My Dishes"
              onClick={() => setLibraryOpen(false)}
            >
<SheetClose aria-label={`Close ${title.toLowerCase()}`}>
